package clean

import (
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

// TestClean is TestRacy with the counter behind a mutex.
func TestClean(t *testing.T) {
	var (
		mu sync.Mutex
		x  int
		wg sync.WaitGroup
	)
	wg.Add(2)
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for j := 0; j < 1000; j++ {
				mu.Lock()
				x++
				mu.Unlock()
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	if x != 2000 {
		t.Fatalf("x = %d", x)
	}
}
